brief: The complete solopreneur stack in 2026. Six tools to run a one-person business from anywhere — landing pages, payments, email, automation, content, support.

slots.tagline: Next.js deploys blazing-fast landing pages that rank and convert visitors into customers.
slots.f1Body: Static and dynamic pages load instantly to improve Core Web Vitals and search rankings.
slots.f2Body: Component-driven architecture lets you iterate on design without rebuilding from scratch.
slots.f3Body: Built-in API endpoints handle form submissions and webhooks without extra infrastructure.

slots.tagline: Stripe processes payments, subscriptions, and invoices so you get paid while you sleep.
slots.f1Body: Hosted payment pages reduce friction and increase conversion rates immediately.
slots.f2Body: Recurring revenue automates itself with flexible plan management and smart retries.
slots.f3Body: Automatic tax calculation keeps you compliant across borders without manual work.

slots.tagline: Airtable organizes contacts, segments audiences, and triggers campaigns like a lightweight CRM.
slots.f1Body: Link tables for leads, campaigns, and content without writing a single query.
slots.f2Body: Filter and group subscribers dynamically to deliver hyper-relevant messaging at scale.
slots.f3Body: Trigger email sequences and status alerts when records hit specific stages.

slots.tagline: Make connects your entire stack and moves data between apps while you focus on growth.
slots.f1Body: Drag-and-drop logic maps complex workflows across APIs without any code.
slots.f2Body: Route data down different paths based on triggers, errors, or custom filters.
slots.f3Body: Sync leads, payments, and content across every tool in your stack.

slots.tagline: Notion doubles as a CMS, blog engine, and wiki to house every piece of content.
slots.f1Body: Turn Notion pages into a public blog or roadmap with simple sharing rules.
slots.f2Body: Draft, edit, and comment in real time without leaving your content workspace.
slots.f3Body: Connect docs, projects, and notes into an internal wiki that scales forever.

slots.tagline: Loom replaces live calls with async video so you can support customers in minutes.
slots.f1Body: Capture bugs, demos, and tutorials with your face and voice in one click.
slots.f2Body: Searchable captions and summaries make every video accessible and easy to reference.
slots.f3Body: Drop videos into Notion, email, or chat to resolve tickets without typing essays.

slots.ctaBody: One person, six tools, zero bloat. Build your own stack and start shipping today.
